description: Import or export volume and value between two countries for one commodity and year, from UN Comtrade. Use for 'how much X did A sell to B'. Pass countries as ISO alpha-3 (IND, GHA) and partner=WLD for the world total. Call trade.codes-equivalent discovery via /v1/trade/codes for valid values. Annual data; the response says whether the rows reconcile with the upstream's own total.

commodity.description: Instrument code with an HS heading. Example: ZR for rice.

flow.description: Direction from the reporter's view. Example: export.

partner.description: Partner country, or WLD for the world total. Example: GHA.

reporter.description: Reporting country, ISO alpha-3 preferred. Example: IND.

name: trade.flow

complete.description: Whether returned rows reconcile with the upstream's World total; null when there is nothing to compare

found.description: False when the upstream has no data for this cell

source.description: series_id is the canonical query; url re-runs it

title: Bilateral Trade Flow
